live_handoff: SESSION 2026-07-26 #7: FOREST-CARRIERS S4 COMPLETE + RELEASED v0.49.0 (develop; master stays v0.48.0) — THE SHARED SHAPE. DISCOVERY: ensure_bind_forest (lexer.cpp) gained arm 2 = the libmadc IMAGE — madc_self_lib_path() (NEW, beside madc_self_exe_path in madc_globals.cpp) dladdr's a libmadc-resident symbol -> image path -> the SAME per-format probe; in the monolithic shape that path IS the exe arm 1 already probed, so it is skipped (unit-pinned). The sidecar arm gained <lib>.forest after <exe>.forest. KEY SEMANTIC: the IMAGE arms (self, libmadc) are deliberately NOT gated by enable_external_forest — the library is the installation the host already loaded, not external redirection — so a STRICT SANDBOXED host still binds its groves; only <exe>.forest / <lib>.forest / $MADC_FOREST are gated. LINK SHAPE: --enable-shared configure axis (AC_ARG_ENABLE -> ENABLE_SHARED_CLI; monolithic stays default) links the CLI against the shared libmadc; LINK_SHAPE_STAMP forces the relink on a shape switch; lib/libmadc.so.0 symlink now exists in the build tree (a -lmadc consumer's DT_NEEDED is the SONAME) and the CLI rpath is $ORIGIN/../lib (resolves in BOTH build and install layouts; @loader_path variant for darwin). In that shape `make release` packs lib/libmadc.so (forest_pack.sh gained --image; it appends to a COPY + mv, since the packer itself has that .so mapped) and `make install` ships the packed library WITHOUT re-stripping (strip discards trailing bytes — the same law as the packed binary; the shared shape strips at release time, BEFORE the pack). PUBLIC API (libmadc/options.h + the 3 policy conversions in madc_program.cpp): compile_options gained enable_forest_bind (ON by default — hosts get grove-backed headers for free; the library twin of --no-forest-bind), forest_missing (madc::forest_policy silent/loud/strict) and enable_external_forest; security_policy gained allow_external_forest, CLAMPED OFF under system_locked authority; a runtime-eval CHILD now INHERITS both forest knobs (latent S3 bug: it reverted to the liberal defaults). REFACTOR: Program::forest_bind_enabled moved into RegistrationPolicy as enable_forest_bind — ONE owner, flowing engine->program->child->host (CLI semantics unchanged: compiles bind, freezes live-parse, so the Program default stays false). BUILD FIX: a bare `make -C src` had built nothing but the forest-shape stamp since v0.48.0 (that rule sits above `all:`, and GNU make takes the FIRST rule as the default goal; explicit goals masked it) — .DEFAULT_GOAL := all is now explicit. GATES: scripts/forest_library_gate.sh permanent in fulltest — 9 legs over a staged bin/+lib/ install using bin/madc-thin (NEW Makefile vehicle: the same madc.o linked shared, so the arm is testable in a monolithic tree; THIN_CLI must be DEFINED EARLY — a prerequisite list is expanded when the rule is READ) + tests/libmadc_forest_smoke.cpp (public-API host; ⚠️ it reports via stdio, NOT cout — a live engine owns cout's streambuf and swallows host writes; likewise madc's stderr is engine-captured, so the strict diagnostic arrives through prog.last_error(), not the terminal). VALIDATION (all green): battery A fulltest 756/0/0/9, --exe 740/0, thin-CLI parity suite 756/0/0/9; battery B (PRODUCT --enable-shared) autoconf+configure, release packs lib/libmadc.so 240 units, packed arbiter 756/0/0/9 through the library carrier, install to DESTDIR (133KB usr/bin/madc + 11.5MB usr/lib/libmadc.so.0) and the INSTALLED CLI binds 240 units via [library-image]; tree reconfigured back to the monolithic default and rebuilt. STATED BOUNDARY (not in this slice): the darwin DYLIB packaging shape (-dynamiclib + @rpath install_name, its -sectcreate carrier, Mac hardware legs) — the hosted darwin build produces no shared library today; the discovery code is platform-neutral (the Mach-O file probe already reads dylibs), so what remains is packaging + hardware validation, and it rides the darwin packaging work. NEXT (forest-carriers plan): S5 -static-libmadc Tier A (the S2 extra-section seam + --pack-forest plumbing IS its carrier; ledger modules built by c2mir at madc build time, cover-analysis selection + merge at emit, LOUD Tier-B refusal); then S6 madc.ini (configure-gated; CLI>env>ini>baked precedence). Deferred residue (LOW): re-signer for rewriting EXISTING signed Mach-O. KNOWN CRUFT: docs/build.md is stale (still documents asmjit) — a small cleanup candidate. STANDING: QNAP never builds/tests (container ssh -p 2299 dev@localhost does ALL; payloads need explicit cd /workspace/madc; capture rc before piping); git commit -F; never git add -A (owner WIP __c-tests-temp.*); cap every test run; one heavy container job (detached nohup runner + rc-file Monitor); CLI flags BEFORE inputs; A QUESTION IS NEVER A DIRECTIVE; SDK NEVER committed/synced; configure is GENERATED/untracked (autoconf in the container after a configure.ac change); frozen forest = THE precompiled-header model BOTH platforms; embedded live-parse = fallback lane + freeze-time input ONLY. VLA sizeof in CONSTANT-required contexts (e.g. `int b[sizeof(vla_a)]`) still folds to 8 via the constant evaluate_type_query path (the expression-path fix doesn't reach it); alignof(vla_var) still reports pointer alignment 8 (gcc: element alignment). Same family, much rarer.

VLA NOT DEALLOCATED ON BACKWARD GOTO: a `goto` jumping back to before a VLA's declaration must deallocate the VLA (gcc/C semantics; gcc-torture 20040811-1.c). madc lowers VLAs as malloc + __attribute__((cleanup)), which frees only on SCOPE EXIT, not on the backward goto re-entering the scope — so a backward-goto loop over a VLA LEAKS one allocation per iteration. 20040811-1.c leaks ~2GB over 1e6 iterations; it passes only when memory is available (it OOM-SIGSEGV'd when the MIR fork's 128MB code-holder reservation reduced headroom — see mir_fork; arch-gated off x86-64, so it passes again). Proper fix: free the VLA at the backward goto. Separate future slice.

MadArray/MadValue namespacing is an open API/ABI follow-up: moving the real C++ types to madc::array and madc::value would give PHP array helpers a normal namespace type surface, but compatibility aliases alone will not preserve old C++ mangled names.

Embedded <iostream> output remains partially staged: cout/cerr/clog still use header-defined stdio-backed ostream bodies. Follow-up is to replace that output surface with real libstdc++ declarations/operators, matching the std::cin direction; do not add stdio.h/FILE* stream bridges.
Real system-header PCH regeneration is deferred until PCH preserves include-guard/macro state; broad regenerated blobs currently duplicate transitive typedefs/declarations.
